pipeline: paper/preprint -> identifier -> metadata -> repository/data -> catalogue -> research network -> UPI source -> evidence matrix -> mirror/lab -> EST|DER|HYP|SYM|STOP
rule: Infrastructure and metadata systems establish traceability/discovery, not truth by themselves.
note: This is a federated map of major open scholarly/research-data services relevant to UPI, not an exhaustive map of every scholarly platform on the Internet.
